cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.

mechanism: A instructs B in supposedly proper relationship accounting while pricing forgiveness or access.
confusable: Ordinary bargaining is insufficient unless A corrects the partner as an unqualified negotiator.
comparison: Opening-night forgiveness trades labor; retrieving records trades access and company.
seedUse: Use the painting and record-return exchanges as causal cores without generic professionalism wrappers.
